name: Vibrobayonet
description: A vibrobayonet was an advanced version of the bayonet. It consisted of a vibroblade that attached to the barrel of a blaster rifle or other rifle, thus turning into a powerful melee weapon. A vibrobayonet detached from a rifle could be used as a vibrodagger.

data.name: Vibrobayonet
data.purpose: Use rifle as spear-like melee weapon
